phase: F14.5 closeout — Foundation Console SSO end-to-end blocker (operator-owned Keycloak)
summary: Foundation Console gateway emits a fully env-driven OIDC authorize URL (no hardcoded client_id/redirect_uri/issuer in FC source). End-to-end SSO is blocked by two operator-owned conditions on the upstream Keycloak realm 'dogan' published behind https://shahin-ai.com/login/.

operator_blockers.description: Probes to https://shahin-ai.com/login/realms/dogan/.well-known/openid-configuration and the authorize endpoint return HTTP 502. The Cloudflare-published upstream for shahin-ai.com (http://127.0.0.1:80) is not currently routing to a live Keycloak instance.
operator_blockers.fc_action: none — FC gateway code/env is correct; no FC change can fix upstream availability

operator_blockers.description: When Keycloak is reachable, realm 'dogan' previously responded 'Client not found' for client_id=foundation-console. The Keycloak admin must register a client with id 'foundation-console', enable Standard Flow + PKCE S256, set Valid Redirect URI 'https://f.shahin-ai.com/auth/callback' and Web Origin 'https://f.shahin-ai.com'.
operator_blockers.fc_action: none — FC gateway env-driven URL is already correct

files_touched_in_closeout: products/foundation-console/ops/systemd/fc-foundation-gateway.service (NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS Environment line confirmed present for prod posture parity with .env)
next_action_required: Operator (a) restore Keycloak service behind https://shahin-ai.com/login/, (b) register OIDC client 'foundation-console' in realm 'dogan' with redirect URI https://f.shahin-ai.com/auth/callback and web origin https://f.shahin-ai.com. After both, re-run /auth/login → complete SSO → /auth/session 200 → fc_sid cookie issued → /api/ui-os/workspace-runtime authenticated 200.
downstream_phases_unblocked_by_this_clos: F15 (production deploy gate) — still depends on F12-0
